symbolDescription:
Every replaceable component.

The last dozen entries are primitives; overriding just those re-skins the whole
editor for a design system.

optionDescriptions.Root: The outermost element, carrying every state attribute the CSS keys off.
optionDescriptions.Toolbar: The toolbar container, including its roving-tabindex keyboard model.
optionDescriptions.ToolbarSeparator: The divider drawn between toolbar groups.
optionDescriptions.ToolbarButton: A toolbar control that performs an action.
optionDescriptions.ToolbarToggle: A toolbar control that reflects a format, with `aria-pressed`.
optionDescriptions.ToolbarDropdown: A toolbar control that opens a list of options.
optionDescriptions.ToolbarOverflow: The menu holding the items that did not fit at this width.
optionDescriptions.ColorPicker: The colour palette shown by the text- and background-colour controls.
optionDescriptions.ContentWrapper: The box around the content, which is what scrolls and grows.
optionDescriptions.Placeholder: The placeholder shown over an empty document.
optionDescriptions.Label: The field label.
optionDescriptions.ErrorText: The validation message, announced when it appears.
optionDescriptions.Footer: The row below the content that holds the helper text and the counter.
optionDescriptions.LinkPopover: The popover for creating and editing links.
optionDescriptions.ImageDialog: The dialog for inserting an image by URL or by file.
optionDescriptions.ImagePopover: The controls shown when an image is selected.
optionDescriptions.UploadPlaceholder: The stand-in shown while a file uploads.
optionDescriptions.TablePicker: The grid for choosing the size of a new table.
optionDescriptions.TableToolbar: The controls shown when the caret is inside a table.
optionDescriptions.InlineSuggestMenu: The shared popover behind the slash, mention, emoji and merge-tag menus.
optionDescriptions.MergeTagChip: One merge tag as it appears inside the document.
optionDescriptions.MentionList: The mention results, including their loading and empty states.
optionDescriptions.FloatingToolbar: The toolbar that follows the selection.
optionDescriptions.BubbleMenu: The bubble menu shown above a non-empty selection.
optionDescriptions.FullscreenPortal: The container the editor moves into in fullscreen mode.
optionDescriptions.RestoreDraftPrompt: The prompt offering to restore an autosaved draft.
optionDescriptions.ShortcutHelpDialog: The keyboard reference, built from the keymap actually in force.
optionDescriptions.Tooltip: Wraps a control with its hover and focus description.
optionDescriptions.Menu: A menu surface with its own focus management.
optionDescriptions.Popover: A positioned surface anchored to an element, closing on Escape and outside click.
optionDescriptions.Dialog: A modal surface that traps focus and returns it to the trigger.
optionDescriptions.IconButton: A button whose label is not visible and so must be given to assistive technology.
optionDescriptions.Checkbox: A two-state control with a visible label.
optionDescriptions.Spinner: The busy indicator, used while uploads and async providers are pending.
